performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may compute one pre-2025 historical descriptive mechanism audit from the exact sealed H1 corpus. It cannot access post-2024 or forward evidence, alter the deployed forward evaluator, define a strategy mapping, compute strategy PnL or drawdown, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy, change canonical state or schedule, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A later independently preregistered matched-capital strategy could evaluate drawdown only after untouched forward evidence supports the same mechanism; all economic and path-risk value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Computing one frozen historical prior now prevents months of passive waiting and can close an unstable direction before strategy engineering, while keeping the cost bounded by forbidding neighboring thresholds, horizons, windows and mappings. A stable prior still waits for the unchanged forward evaluator rather than consuming candidate budget.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its value is increasing mechanism-learning throughput and rejecting or preserving exactly one continuation or reversal prior before any matched-capital strategy specification is attempted.
